composition.serve_who: This is the Hall Spars mast layout (drawing P03818-01 / SW108-01, "MAST LAYOUT PRELIM FOR CONTRACT REVIEW"). It is a building/structural GA of the carbon mast spar and its fittings — a section-by-section elevation and cross-sections showing masthead, spreaders, gooseneck/collar, mast base, hardware positions and dimensions. Nearly all callouts (tangs, sheave boxes, locks, hydraulic exits, jammers, cleats, halyard locks, deflectors, mast jacks, builder's step, drain exit, cut tube) are physical fittings ON the mast structure itself, so they belong to the Mast register node (810-hall-spars-manual-20sep2023). A few callouts reference equipment served BY the mast (nav lights, deck light, steaming light, radar dome, tracphone/VHF dome, horn, windex/wand, camera) which belong to their own equipment nodes per the register, with the mast sheet giving their POSITION on the spar only.

equipment_groups.equipment_name: Hall Spars Carbon Mast (spar structure, spreaders, standing rigging fittings, running rigging exits)
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: The sheet title block reads 'MAST LAYOUT', project components list 'MAST SECTION: 500C', 'BOOM SECTION: 650D Maxi Rack', finish/paint/rigging specs, and the entire drawing is an elevation + sections of the spar itself with fitting call-outs (tangs, sheave boxes, locks, deflectors, jammers, cleats, exits). This is the Hall Spars mast structural GA — all structural/fitting facts attach to the Mast node.

functions.label: Standing rigging termination points along the mast (caps, verticals, diagonals, checkstays, babystay, backstay, runners)
functions.what_it_does: Provides fixed attachment points (tangs, dead-ends, sheave boxes) at masthead, spreader levels 1-4, and base for all standing rigging legs (V1-V4, D1-D4, cap shrouds, babystay, checkstay/backstay deflector) that hold the mast in column.
key_components: 34980 Checkstay/BS deflector combination tang (P&S, 1st dog bone tang)
functions.dry_data: Mast section 500C, 43.310mm P (luff length), IG 12.060mm, J 42.680mm, E 14.330mm, BAS 2.800mm, ISP 15.750mm, SPL/STL, bury 2.696mm, 1/2 CFW 3.191mm, base rake 2°, spreader sweep 22°.
functions.sheet_region: Left full-height elevation (port profile) and centre 'view in spreader plane' + 'view from boat CL' sections

functions.label: Spreaders 1-4
functions.what_it_does: Support the diagonal (D1-D4) and vertical (V1-V4) shroud legs at four levels, spacing them off the mast to control column buckling; angles and lengths given per spreader.
functions.dry_data: Spreader angles/offsets: e.g. Spreader top 2004/2173mm at ~8.4°/10.6°; Spreader 3 2783/3015mm at 5.1°/22.0°; Spreader 2 3173/3428mm at 3.2°/22.0°; Spreader 1 3304/3566mm at 2.3°/22.0°. Sweep 22° per rig dimension table.
functions.sheet_region: Left elevation, height callouts 9058/17852/26562/35232; centre spreader-plane view

functions.label: Reef, halyard, lock and sheave hardware set at masthead/gooseneck
functions.what_it_does: Provides locking, hoisting and reefing points for sails and halyards run internal/external to the spar: frac hoist sheave, IM/IG locks, jib lock, reef 1-3 dead ends/locks, IFS lock, storm sail sheave box.

flow_scenarios.path: halyard led internally from exit slot at base → up mast core → over sheave at masthead/frac sheave box → down to lock/jammer at deck level for load holding

key_components: 40390/34890/29260 Reef 1-3 (preliminary — dead ends/locks not fully confirmed)
functions.dry_data: Sheave sizes #100-#130, purchases 1:1/2:1, SWL 1st/preliminary values as noted; reef positions marked 'preliminary' on drawing.
functions.sheet_region: Top of left elevation (masthead detail) and mid-elevation reef callouts

functions.label: Gooseneck / collar / mast base structural fittings and deck-level rigging exits
functions.what_it_does: Terminates boom at gooseneck, provides exits for hydraulic hose, halyard, vang, lazyjack, cunningham, tack lines and jammers/cleats/locks at the base of the mast, plus mast jacks and builder's step for stepping the spar.

flow_scenarios.path: hydraulic hose enters mast base at 'exit slot HYD + electrics' → routed internally up mast → exits at mainsheet/reefing/cunningham/backstay deflector exit through mast step

line run from sail/boom fitting → through internal mast core or external track → down to jammer/cleat/lock at collar (e.g. 1697 jammers, 1392 reef tack, 1100 lazyjack jammers, 924 hyd exit) → cleated/locked at base for crew control

key_components: 1950/1697/1392/1100 Jammers, reef tack, lazyjack jammers (roles: lock/hold line under load)
functions.dry_data: Boom topper 2:1 (slot 25x150); frac hyd 2:1 (slot 25x150); MH stbd hyd lock/jammer (slot 25x100); main hyd lock (slot 15x100); mast jacks RC-750 (2x).
functions.sheet_region: Bottom half of centre elevation views (three parallel sections) and base cross-section detail lower-right

flow_scenarios.path: lightning strike at masthead tip → down through B&G wand mount/head fitting → (implied) down mast conductor to base — path only partially shown, no continuation drawn below masthead detail

functions.dry_data: Masthead detail dimensions 350mm, 2004mm, 2173mm span shown in top-right elevation inset.
